claims.statement: Carrier pickup slot booking feed to east-node carrier has a lag that prevents timely slot confirmation, blocking pickup collection for all orders routed to that feed
claims.corroboration: m8_r_owner (tier-1 Carrier Ops): explicitly references 'the affected feed and its lag'; m8_r_exceptions (tier-1 DISCRIMINATING): 100% of held orders are v18-routed to east node; m8_e02 (tier-1): lag only on east-node lanes, other nodes normal
claims.limitation: Lag mechanism (booking queue, sync delay, partition offset) not yet identified; would be confirmed by read_partition_offsets or trace_cohort_handoffs

capability_gaps.capability: Direct visibility into carrier system pickup slot acceptance
capability_gaps.reason: m8_e09 documents gap: dashboards cannot show booked pickup relationship to carrier's own confirmation

next_action.rationale: Root cause identified as carrier feed lag. This diagnostic will confirm whether the lag is in message partition offsets (unprocessed pickup requests), queue depth, or a sync delay between our allocation booking and carrier's slot confirmation system. This completes the discriminating evidence before mitigation.
next_action.expected_information_gain: Will show if east-node carrier feed partition has lagged offsets or if the booking queue has accumulated unprocessed requests, confirming the feed lag mechanism and readiness for apply_slot_correction mitigation.
